correctness.rationale: The geometric sources give the transitive 36-point orbit, dihedral order-ten stabilizers, reflection axes, and faithful stabilizer action on the five incident lines. The unique order-five subgroup of each stabilizer bijects the orbit with the 36 such subgroups; the stabilizer is its normalizer. A stabilizing involution cannot have the point as isolated center because then it fixes the pencil pointwise; hence its axis is incident. The five such involutions exhaust the incidences at that point. I constructed the matrix independently: cycle each five-element subset and enumerate its reflections j↦k−j, deduplicating the reflection sets. This gives 81 vertices, 180 edges and the two stated degrees. The cofactor determinant and Laplacian characteristic polynomial confirm connectivity, the claimed spectrum products and 2^56·3^24·5^25 trees. Exact integer Smith form gives 1(52), 2(8), 4(3), 20, 60(8), 1800(8), with multiplicities in parentheses. The finite graph proof neither assumes sampled geometry nor uses the other Wiman strata.
